ideas.pitch: A real-time prompt-chaining canvas for creative artists that transforms mood boards and rough sketches into cohesive multi-genre musical themes and narrative backstories.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering the Creative Artist (Open Track): Storytelling & Narrative Assistants and generative art tooling.
ideas.title: MuseMesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the open track with a highly polished visual UI that solves a real creative workflow bottleneck rather than just returning static text.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent co-writing diagnostic tool that tracks pacing, character voice consistency, and thematic arc drift in screenplays and short stories.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering the Creative Artist (Open Track): GenAI co-writers that help authors overcome writer's block and refine narrative structure.
ideas.title: ScriptDoctor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a painful, highly relatable problem for writers and content creators, featuring structured multi-step analysis instead of a generic prompt box.

ideas.pitch: A semantic prompt router and lyric generation workspace that matches regional Indian folk rhythms and modern chord progressions to user-defined emotional prompts.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering the Creative Artist (Open Track): Music is composed and digital art is created with GenAI support.
ideas.title: LyricForge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tailored directly to local creative contexts in Kolkata, giving judges a culturally resonant and highly demonstrable product live.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered design asset generator that reads prose descriptions from independent comic artists and generates consistent character model sheets and color palettes.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering the Creative Artist (Open Track): Digital art is created and styled consistently through human-in-the-loop prompt engineering.
ideas.title: PaletteSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the notorious consistency problem in generative AI art, appealing directly to digital illustrators and comic creators in the room.

ideas.pitch: An interactive audiobook prompt director that lets voice actors and indie podcasters direct synthetic voice performances using emotive prompt modifiers and punctuation cues.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering the Creative Artist (Open Track): Narrative assistants and audio performance tools.
ideas.title: VoiceCraft Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on fine-grained control over audio generation, shifting the narrative from passive generation to active human-in-the-loop creative direction.
